about: Compact AI models to download, in priority order. Source of truth for the app's catalog (src/lib/microai/modelQueue.ts), the rig's downloader (command_station/tools/model_queue.py) and docs/MODEL_QUEUE.md. 'repo' corrects an id that is not a Hugging Face repository as written; repo null means it is published elsewhere ('source').

sections.multimodal: Multimodal, OCR, documents, and asset understanding
